scenario.title: Hours and location
scenario.situation: You are planning a visit and want to know the address, Saturday hours and parking.
scenario.objective: Get hours and location, clarify whether Saturday visits are actually available.
scenario.probes: Ask whether walk-ins are accepted; repeat back the key details.
scenario.expected: Consistent information and explicit uncertainty; weekend closure is not assumed.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: I learned that the clinic is at 1234 Recovery Way, Suite 200, Austin, with free front parking, open Monday to Friday, closed Saturdays, and no walk-ins allowed.
